import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Get all project heading links (level 2) which should correspond to the top projects
    project_links = page.get_by_role('heading', level=2).get_by_role('link')
    count = await project_links.count()
    
    # Iterate through the first four projects
    for i in range(min(4, count)):
        # Click the project link to navigate to its page
        await project_links.nth(i).click()
        await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for the page to load
        
        # Find and click the star button on the project page
        star_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Star')
        if await star_button.count() > 0:
            await star_button.click()
            await asyncio.sleep(1)  # Wait for the action to complete
        
        # Navigate back to the explore projects page to star the next project
        await page.goto('/explore/projects/starred')
        await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for the page to load
    
    # After starring all four, no further action needed
    return "Starred the top four most starred repositories."
